thread:
maria_cs: FYI escalation from ACCT-xxx. Customer says they applied two promo codes via the API and only the second one shows up in billing. They expected stacking. ticket: TKT-5421

arjun_support: Can you paste the minimal repro steps and the API payloads?

maria_cs: Repro steps from the customer: 1) POST /v1/accounts/ACCT-REDACT/promos/apply {"code":"WELCOME50"} -> 200 OK, promo_applied. 2) POST /v1/accounts/ACCT-REDACT/promos/apply {"code":"NEWUSER25"} -> 200 OK, promo_applied. After second call, account shows only NEWUSER25 in UI and billing credits reflect NEWUSER25 only.

promo-bot: [system] event: promo_applied account=ACCT-REDACT promo_id=WELCOME50 ts=2028-10-02T14:05:12Z
promo-bot: [system] event: promo_applied account=ACCT-REDACT promo_id=NEWUSER25 ts=2028-10-02T14:06:03Z

devon_billing: Thanks — can you share the response bodies for each apply call? need to confirm whether the API returned an "attachment" id or a replacement flag.

maria_cs: Response snippets (redacted):
```
POST /v1/accounts/ACCT-REDACT/promos/apply
200 OK
{"status":"applied","promo":"WELCOME50","effective_credits":5000}
```
```
POST /v1/accounts/ACCT-REDACT/promos/apply
200 OK
{"status":"applied","promo":"NEWUSER25","effective_credits":2500}
```
No errors, both look normal.

arjun_support: Hmm. Do we have a concept in the backend where applying a promo clears existing attachments unless flagged? I remember a change in the legacy attach flow. @oliver_sre any idea? :thinking_face: 

oliver_sre: Looking at the promo service code path — current handler uses upsert semantics on the account_promo table keyed by account_id + promo_type which means second apply will replace previous promo for same promo_type. If both promos are same type (e.g., "trial_credit"), they will overwrite.

devon_billing: That matches. We used to allow stacking of different promo types (credit vs discount) but not multiple trial credits. Customer expected two trial credits to stack.

maria_cs: Customer insists docs said "multiple promo codes can be applied". We need a clear answer to them and a workaround.

oliver_sre: Short term workaround: grant an explicit ephemeral credit via billing API: POST /v1/accounts/ACCT-REDACT/credits {"amount":5000,"reason":"manual work-around for stacking"} — that will add balance without touching promo attachments. Medium term: change apply endpoint to accept query param ?stack=true or let promo_type be listable and allow multiple attachments per type.

arjun_support: Can we confirm whether UI behaves the same? if UI shows only the latest, it's not just API.

maria_cs: UI shows only NEWUSER25 as well. Customer attached screenshots.

devon_billing: For this ticket: propose we 1) offer immediate credit grant and apology, 2) document current stacking semantics clearly, 3) file an engineering change request to support stacking for trial_credit promo_type. I'll draft the billing response.

oliver_sre: Filed infra ticket INF-3019 to make promo attachments append-only by default and add a flag to replace existing for cases that should. Engineer notes: migration needed for uniqueness constraints; need product signoff on semantics.

arjun_support: Thanks — maria, please offer the credit workaround and notify customer of the planned change. Also ask whether they want the two promos combined or prefer the manual credit amount.

maria_cs: Doing that now. Replying to customer with options + ETA for engineering followup. I'll mark this thread resolved once they confirm. :white_check_mark:

promo-bot: [system] note: ticket TKT-5421 updated; assigned=devon_billing, infra_ticket=INF-3019

maria_cs: Closing loop here — customer accepted manual credit and asked to be notified when stacking is supported. Leaving TKT-5421 open for follow-up.
